Class DebugDump

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.DebugDump
final class DebugDump extends Object
Saves exactly what the agent was shown: the raw frame, the masks extracted from it and the mask statistics. When something looks wrong with the agent's vision these three files say why.
